companyFieldUpdates.description: Port Arthur LNG is a two-phase liquefied-natural-gas export development in Jefferson County, Texas. Phase 1 comprises two liquefaction trains with approximately 13 Mtpa of nameplate capacity and is owned indirectly by KKR Denali (42%), Sempra Infrastructure Partners (28%) and ConocoPhillips (30%). Phase 2 adds approximately 13 Mtpa across two further trains and reached FID in September 2025; its direct legal members hold 50.1%, 40.0% and 9.9% interests, with KKR participating within the 40% member's parent consortium. The project is distinct from Sempra Infrastructure Partners, whose separate KKR-led platform transaction remained pending as of the latest verification.
